fingerprint.retryAgain: That one didn't read, try again
fingerprint.retryCenter: Not centered: use the middle of the sensor
fingerprint.retryLift: Lift your finger off the sensor, then try again
fingerprint.failFull: The reader has no room for another fingerprint
fingerprint.failEnroll: The scan stopped before it finished
fingerprint.verify.start: Press Enter or V, then touch the reader
fingerprint.verify.none: Enroll a finger to test it here
fingerprint.error.permissionDenied: Not authorized to use the fingerprint reader
fingerprint.error.inUse: The fingerprint reader is in use by another program
fingerprint.error.noPrints: No fingerprints enrolled on this reader
fingerprint.error.noDevice: The fingerprint reader is no longer available
fingerprint.pamHint: sudo and polkit don't ask for fingerprints on this machine yet. An administrator can turn that on with omarchy-setup-security-fingerprint.
fingerprint.keys: Arrows or 1–6 choose · Enter enrolls · Del deletes · V tests · Esc closes
